data.gender_notes: Parshuram is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Parshurama, the sixth avatar of Lord Vishnu, was born to rid the earth of the Kshatriyas who had forgotten their duty as protectors of the people. He wielded an axe and was invincible in battle. The name Parshuram carries the meaning “Rama with axe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Parshuram usually hope their child will grow to embody rama with axe and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Parshuram total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: Parshurama is revered as the ultimate warrior in Indian tradition, depicted as the embodiment of strength, courage and martial prowess. His story is included in various Puranas and epics such as the Mahabharata and the Ramayana. He is also known for his altercation with the sage Kashyapa, which led to the destruction of the vast Drisadvatam forest. Parshurama is also believed to have revived the art of archery in the world, by teaching it to the great sage Dronacharya.
data.spiritual_significance: Parshurama is considered a manifestation of Lord Vishnu, who took birth on earth to establish Dharma - righteous living, and purify society by eliminating the corrupt and unjust. His life teaches us the importance of duty, self-sacrifice, martial skills and adherence to Dharma. Parshurama's rage and destructive tendencies are a reminder of the consequences of forgetting our duties and the need for balance and restraint.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Parshuram symbolizes raw power and determination, embodying the warrior spirit. His name means "Rama with the axe," reflecting his strength and unwavering devotion to his cause.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Parshuram remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.

name_in_real_life.story: Rahul Parshuram from Mumbai, India embodies the meaning of Parshuram - "Rama with axe". Growing up in a Hindu family, they were taught to honor the spiritual significance of their name and live according to dharma.
